function handleEarthResize(s): void;

Defined in: experiments/earth-playground/earth/runtime/frame.ts:38

Resize step: measures the shadow host first, then the canvas parent, then the window — the canvas lives inside SpacePlayground's shadow root, so clientWidth must come from the host, not the element. Pixel ratio = min(devicePixelRatio, 2) × resolutionScale — the cap at 2 prevents 3x-phone GPU fill-rate blowout.
